headline: Congress in recess mode with both chambers holding pro forma sessions only, minimal action before Thursday's return.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a brief pro forma session on Monday, August 17, convening for less than a minute and adjourning until Thursday. No business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for eight minutes on Monday, August 17, in a brief morning session. Nine bills and one resolution were introduced, but no votes were taken.
